discoveries: DISCOVERY: every D_p lies in the S_4 permutation algebra of the four q2 wires (it commutes with U^(x4), U in SU(2)), so it splits into total-spin blocks J = 2, 1, 0 with multiplicities 1, 3, 2: the J = 2 coupling is nonzero only in the unitary sector p6, J = 1 is rank 1 in p0,1,2,4,5,7 and zero in p3, J = 0 is rank 1 for p != 6. In the J = 1 pair basis ((10), (01), (11)) the f = 0 singular vectors are e(01) (p1,5,7), e(10) (p2), w = (1,-1,sqrt2)/2 (p0,4) and the f = 1 vectors are a = (1,-1,-sqrt2)/2 (p0,1,2), b = (-1,1,-sqrt2)/2 (p7), e(10) (p4,5). Overlaps of 1/2 force two frame classes on each f side, and p1, p2 (same f = 1 vector a, orthogonal f = 0 vectors) force a third (pair of frames), whatever unitaries are used.

DISCOVERY: negative, by exhaustive check in the 6-dim multiplicity space (exact K test: diagonal in the (01)(23) pair basis, real, equal (11) values across J): two controlled gates G2^c G1^f B with G = exp(i theta P_singlet(pair)) (theta on the k pi/12 grid, all pairs, all 24 global relabels B) have no solution with G1 controlled by f alone. With both controls arbitrary (theta in {pi, +-pi/2, +-2pi/3}), the only solutions are the swaps (0 2), (1 3) (32 relabelings). In all 4096 control pairs neither control is f-independent, alpha^beta is never affine and never a two-literal AND, and at most one control is a two-literal AND. Three partial-swap gates with affine controls: no solution (25^3 ordered gates x 3 middle pairings). So the 12 CX per side of control lines is the floor for every two-gate SU(2)-invariant leg.

DISCOVERY: CX ties at 83 for every local rewrite counted. Expanding W or V into decoded bits removes 6 AND CX but needs a 16-term walk (>= 15 CX with a free start). A singlet-indicator toggle t ^= s(q_i, q_j) done in the raw q2 frame (no Bell decoder; the 4 target-involving pi/8 rotations of <X_t, Z_iZ_j, X_iX_j>, end frame only required to keep Z_t) needs exactly 4 CX (BFS over 3-qubit Clifford classes mod local Cliffords: none with 3). So a toggle pair costs 8 CX, the same as 2 shared decoder CX + 2 rccx. The ch macro (1 CX) gives an exact AND onto a clean target as ch(b,t) cz(a,t) ch(b,t), which is also 3 CX and 4 T.
summary: no new datapath beats the floor, so this is the r10-F2-010 circuit re-entered under F3 (parity frame, L: 0 -> ~p_t&~s_r [(1 3) 7-T Fredkin] -> g, a: 0 -> f&~g [(0 2) Fredkin] -> 0 -> w23 fused, w01 toggled onto the p_r wire inside the H(f) window, 9-term 9-CX open R_x walk, the archived per-class k pi/2 word shifts, no new angle choices); round 12 tested legs built from other SU(2)-invariant gates (controlled partial swaps exp(i theta c P_singlet) at any pair, angle and control) and found none valid (notes below); 83 CX, T_eps 638, depth_CT 1521, 10 qubits.
